sample_unit: patient education materials (ChatGPT-4 output vs five websites)

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Flesch Reading Ease) of ChatGPT-4 vs human TKA patient education materials
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 PEMs had significantly higher reading grade level and lower reading ease than human-generated PEMs (p<0.001); authors recommend against current use due to readability.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 PEMs demonstrated a significantly higher reading grade level and lower reading ease score compared to human-generated PEMs (<0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the readability and quality of patient education materials generated by ChatGPT-4 compared to human-written materials, but does not test specific guardrails or deployment practices.
